statusDetail: Atomic audit completed across portal, storefront, product, registration and failure-state archetypes. Not covered: authenticated checkout/payment completion, account management, adult-only section variants and every category template; these require credentials, a transaction or are represented by the same shared storefront shell.

page.framework: Legacy server-rendered MPA with Vue/jQuery/Swiper-enhanced storefront and separate Vivion ID auth service
page.notes: Public commerce/catalogue site with locale variants. Mobile requests redirect to a home-touch route in Lighthouse, while desktop routes declare width=1024.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark-media screenshots are pixel-identical to light captures and computed color-scheme is normal; storefront and registration remain white.
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, four 500–1000 ms animations and many transitions remained configured.
Under prefers-contrast: more, text and controls remained visible and keyboard focus exposed a 1px auto outline.
DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition usage on route-rich storefront/product navigation.
No scroll-linked visual effect requiring a scroll event handler was observed; the page uses ordinary scrolling and static sections.
Carousel-heavy storefront uses Swiper 4 and no declarative scroll-snap/overscroll signal was found in the inspected UI/CSS.
The long storefront has static dense chrome and no scroll-state container-query signal or progress/compact state in inspected CSS.
Multiple dropdown/overlay classes exist, but no anchor positioning or semantic popover was present in the rendered DOM.
Visible category tabs, breadcrumbs on product metadata, section headings and ranking labels consistently communicate location and next navigation choices.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using home-desktop.png, product-desktop.png, register-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Every fresh storefront/product load is covered by a full-page language modal, and registration is covered by a persistent consent banner.
The blocking language chooser is a fixed DIV; probes found zero dialog, popover, and details elements.
The mobile storefront is a scaled 1024px desktop canvas with stacked campaign, search, category and side-navigation chrome, leaving tiny content.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-mobile.png, product-mobile.png, store-mobile-layout.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport the site declares viewport width=1024; layout metrics report innerWidth 1024 and Chrome scales the entire desktop layout to 35%, producing unreadably small UI.
The rendered storefront CSS probe found no @container signal; cards and navigation remain desktop-scaled instead of adapting locally.
Lighthouse failed target-size on the mobile storefront; scaled desktop controls become very small, although focus outline is present.
Storefront title/search/categories and product title, price and purchase buttons make browsing and buying purpose clear after the locale gate.
A fresh product journey is blocked before interaction by a locale overlay even when locale=ja_JP is in the URL; registration then adds a second consent obstruction.
Invalid email uses browser validation, and an invalid storefront URL returns an intentional HTTP 404 page rather than a false success or blank shell.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 34.3s, TBT 1.62s and performance 0.28; trace on desktop still measured LCP 4.82s and TBT 204ms.
Layout observer measured CLS 0.091 on storefront and 0.089 on product, within the good <0.1 threshold despite image sizing opportunities.
Trace recorded six long tasks, longest 186ms and 204ms TBT; Lighthouse mobile reported 11.2s main-thread work and 6.7s JS execution.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-summary.json, store-resource-dom-confirmation.json, lighthouse-mobile-summary.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded 398 requests/5.88MB, ten parser-inserted VeryHigh stylesheets and missing cache headers; mobile Lighthouse found 11.79MB and redirect/cache failures.
Lighthouse estimated 1,728KiB unused JavaScript and 156KiB unused CSS; HAR includes 119 scripts and repeated TikTok/Google/Facebook tags.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using lighthouse-mobile-summary.json, store-images.json, register-probe.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name and ARIA parent checks; probes found 17 scanned images missing alt and the registration email has no associated label.
Lighthouse failed color contrast on both storefront and registration.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-probe.json, register-probe.json, lighthouse-register-summary.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Registration has duplicate H1s and no main landmark per Lighthouse; storefront begins with modal H1 before page H1 and has ARIA structure failures.
The 1024px canvas is scaled to 35% on a 360px device, making navigation, product metadata and side filters extremely small.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using register-probe.json, lighthouse-register-summary.json, lighthouse-mobile-summary.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Registration sets maximum-scale=1 and Lighthouse fails meta-viewport; storefront also fails target-size and uses a fixed 1024px viewport.
Lighthouse reported browser console errors on both storefront and registration.
Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audit found 66/100 missing dimensions, 36 below-fold images not lazy and six oversized.
Lighthouse found missing source maps, DevTools inspector issues and three BFCache failure reasons.
Storefront and product expose distinct descriptive titles and meta descriptions in rendered and raw HTML.
Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchors; 21 storefront links are missing href or use #, and fixed width=1024 defeats mobile-friendly rendering.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-probe.json, product-probe.json, robots.txt
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTP 200 pages have canonical URLs; robots.txt permits public core pages and publishes section sitemap indexes.
Storefront has WebSite JSON-LD and Open Graph data; product has breadcrumb JSON-LD plus matching title, description, URL and image previews.
HTTPS/HSTS and frame protection exist, but 31 cookies were marked insecure, most SameSite=None; CSP only declares frame-ancestors and nosniff is absent.
Tracker probe found 41 third-party origins and eight known tracker domains; HAR attributes 315 requests/3.63MB to third parties on first load.
No permission prompt fired on load, but registration exposes social/email account creation and no passkey/WebAuthn option or credential autocomplete was found.
Headers lack Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; CSP is limited to frame-ancestors. HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are present.
Non-JS discoverability is only 35% on storefront; crawler screenshot loses main rankings/product content and leaves a large blank content region.
Blocking locale UI is custom fixed DIV rather than top-layer dialog/popover; it obscures every deep link and lacks declarative dismissal semantics.

checkOutcomes.method: Applicability judgement from representative path recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: DLsite is an intrinsically online commerce/catalogue service; installability and offline transaction support are not required for the representative public purchase journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: DLsite is an intrinsically online commerce/catalogue service; installability and offline transaction support are not required for the representative public purchase journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A nonexistent storefront route returns HTTP 404 with a branded 404 document instead of a blank shell or misleading 200.
Japanese and English routes set ja-JP/en-US correctly and provide a 14-language selector.
English locale changes document language/title and exposes locale-specific translated catalogue links; Japanese prices/content are localised on product/store screens.

checkOutcomes.method: Applicability judgement from representative path recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited catalogue, product and registration surfaces expose no user-scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive data requiring DST coordination.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited catalogue, product and registration surfaces expose no user-scheduled event or time-zone-sensitive data requiring DST coordination.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-cookies.json, store-trackers.json, store-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Before any visible consent choice on the storefront, 31 cookies and 41 third-party origins are active; the only first-load prompt is a compulsory language gate.
After entering an invalid email and blurring, browser validity fails but no visible error, aria-invalid or described-by error is added.
Registration email has no label and no autocomplete token, preventing reliable autofill assistance.
Pricing and purchase actions are visible, but a first-time product deep link is blocked by locale selection and registration is partly hidden by consent UI.
Image audit found six oversized images, 40 without srcset, seven legacy-format images and 36 below-fold images loaded eagerly.
First load makes 398 requests including 73 fetch/XHR and repeated analytics scripts; 119 scripts contribute to long tasks and unused code.
Third parties consume 3.63MB across 315 requests, including 1.57MB Google Tag Manager and multiple ad/analytics vendors.
This commerce site is a plausible agentic purchasing/search surface, but Lighthouse agentic score is 0.32 and no WebMCP tools are registered.

checkOutcomes.method: Applicability judgement from representative path recon
checkOutcomes.evidence: No audited task clearly benefits from built-in on-device inference; catalogue search and purchase do not require a local language model.
checkOutcomes.reason: No audited task clearly benefits from built-in on-device inference; catalogue search and purchase do not require a local language model.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten repeated scroll cycles, heap self size rose only 0.30MB (99.51MB to 99.81MB, about 0.3%); no Detached constructor appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Active audit using store-heap-baseline.json, store-probe.json, store-summary.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1.57M heap nodes and 99.5MB self size for a catalogue landing page, alongside 6,650 DOM elements and 119 scripts.
Before/after heap summaries expose no Detached constructor; Set count stayed flat and the small post-scroll growth does not show unbounded accumulation.

paths.description: Global portal and first-visit language-selection state; represents entry and locale choice.
Doujin storefront home; represents navigation, search, rankings, listing cards and initial browsing.
Representative sitemap product detail; represents product metadata, pricing, purchase entry and recommendations.
Registration path reached from account flow; represents a primary form, consent and validation.
Deliberately invalid storefront route; represents HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.summary: Dark-media screenshots are pixel-identical to light captures and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.evidence: Dark-media screenshots are pixel-identical to light captures and computed color-scheme is normal; storefront and registration remain white.
findings.suggestedFix: Add system-driven light/dark tokens with color-scheme and prefers-color-scheme.

findings.summary: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, four 500–1000 ms animations and many transitions remained configured..
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, four 500–1000 ms animations and many transitions remained configured.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animations and shorten essential transitions in a reduce media query.

findings.summary: DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition usage on route-rich storefront/product navigation..
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probe found no view-transition usage on route-rich storefront/product navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document or same-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Carousel-heavy storefront uses Swiper 4 and no declarative scroll-snap/overscroll signal was found in the inspected UI/CSS..
findings.evidence: Carousel-heavy storefront uses Swiper 4 and no declarative scroll-snap/overscroll signal was found in the inspected UI/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Move carousel interaction to native overflow plus scroll-snap where feasible, retaining pointer and keyboard controls.

findings.summary: The long storefront has static dense chrome and no scroll-state container-query signal or progress/compact state in inspected CSS..
findings.evidence: The long storefront has static dense chrome and no scroll-state container-query signal or progress/compact state in inspected CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state-aware sticky chrome or a compact header to preserve orientation without consuming the viewport.

findings.summary: Multiple dropdown/overlay classes exist, but no anchor positioning or semantic popover was present in the rendered DOM..
findings.evidence: Multiple dropdown/overlay classes exist, but no anchor positioning or semantic popover was present in the rendered DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and fallback positions for menus/tooltips.

findings.summary: Every fresh storefront/product load is covered by a full-page language modal, and registration is covered by a persistent consent banner..
findings.evidence: Every fresh storefront/product load is covered by a full-page language modal, and registration is covered by a persistent consent banner.
findings.suggestedFix: Persist locale earlier, avoid blocking repeat URL-locale visits, and make non-essential banners non-obscuring and dismissible.

findings.summary: The blocking language chooser is a fixed DIV.
findings.evidence: The blocking language chooser is a fixed DIV; probes found zero dialog, popover, and details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the blocking flow as a labelled dialog and transient UI with popover/light-dismiss.

findings.summary: The mobile storefront is a scaled 1024px desktop canvas with stacked campaign, search, category and side-navigation chrome, leaving tiny content..
findings.evidence: The mobile storefront is a scaled 1024px desktop canvas with stacked campaign, search, category and side-navigation chrome, leaving tiny content.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise search/results and progressively disclose secondary campaign and category chrome on small screens.

findings.summary: At a requested 360x800 viewport the site declares viewport width=1024.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport the site declares viewport width=1024; layout metrics report innerWidth 1024 and Chrome scales the entire desktop layout to 35%, producing unreadably small UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, intrinsic fluid layout and responsive card/navigation patterns rather than a fixed 1024px viewport.

findings.summary: The rendered storefront CSS probe found no @container signal.
findings.evidence: The rendered storefront CSS probe found no @container signal; cards and navigation remain desktop-scaled instead of adapting locally.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reused card, ranking, search and navigation components.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed target-size on the mobile storefront.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size on the mobile storefront; scaled desktop controls become very small, although focus outline is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24–44 CSS px targets with spacing, keyboard-visible focus and non-hover alternatives.

findings.summary: A fresh product journey is blocked before interaction by a locale overlay even when locale=ja_JP is in the URL.
findings.evidence: A fresh product journey is blocked before interaction by a locale overlay even when locale=ja_JP is in the URL; registration then adds a second consent obstruction.
findings.suggestedFix: Persist locale without blocking deep links and keep registration/purchase steps unobscured with clear continuity.

findings.summary: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 34.3s, TBT 1.62s and performance 0.28.
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 34.3s, TBT 1.62s and performance 0.28; trace on desktop still measured LCP 4.82s and TBT 204ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise LCP content, remove redirects and third-party startup work, and split/defer non-critical JavaScript.

findings.summary: Trace recorded six long tasks, longest 186ms and 204ms TBT.
findings.evidence: Trace recorded six long tasks, longest 186ms and 204ms TBT; Lighthouse mobile reported 11.2s main-thread work and 6.7s JS execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant trackers, split long tasks, schedule lower-priority work and lazy-initialise below-fold widgets.

findings.summary: HAR recorded 398 requests/5.88MB, ten parser-inserted VeryHigh stylesheets and missing cache headers.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 398 requests/5.88MB, ten parser-inserted VeryHigh stylesheets and missing cache headers; mobile Lighthouse found 11.79MB and redirect/cache failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, remove redirect chains and apply long-lived caching to versioned assets.

findings.summary: Lighthouse estimated 1,728KiB unused JavaScript and 156KiB unused CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,728KiB unused JavaScript and 156KiB unused CSS; HAR includes 119 scripts and repeated TikTok/Google/Facebook tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit tag-manager containers and route bundles, deduplicate trackers, tree-shake and load features conditionally.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed button-name and ARIA parent checks.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name and ARIA parent checks; probes found 17 scanned images missing alt and the registration email has no associated label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls accessible names, correct ARIA ownership, explicit form labels and meaningful image alternatives.

findings.summary: Lighthouse failed color contrast on both storefront and registration..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color contrast on both storefront and registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text/control contrast to WCAG AA and verify every state, including banners and disabled steps.

findings.summary: Registration has duplicate H1s and no main landmark per Lighthouse.
findings.evidence: Registration has duplicate H1s and no main landmark per Lighthouse; storefront begins with modal H1 before page H1 and has ARIA structure failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page H1, semantic main/nav landmarks, correct ARIA ownership and managed modal focus.

findings.summary: The 1024px canvas is scaled to 35% on a 360px device, making navigation, product metadata and side filters extremely small..
findings.evidence: The 1024px canvas is scaled to 35% on a 360px device, making navigation, product metadata and side filters extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt device-width reflow and readable fluid type/line lengths rather than shrinking the desktop page.

findings.summary: Registration sets maximum-scale=1 and Lighthouse fails meta-viewport.
findings.evidence: Registration sets maximum-scale=1 and Lighthouse fails meta-viewport; storefront also fails target-size and uses a fixed 1024px viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale, use device-width and ensure usable reflow, zoom and touch target sizing.

findings.summary: Lighthouse reported browser console errors on both storefront and registration..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported browser console errors on both storefront and registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate first- and third-party console errors and guard failed integrations without noisy uncaught failures.

findings.summary: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audit found 66/100 missing dimensions, 36 below-fold images not lazy and six oversized..
findings.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audit found 66/100 missing dimensions, 36 below-fold images not lazy and six oversized.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources and loading priority/lazy-loading according to viewport relevance.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found missing source maps, DevTools inspector issues and three BFCache failure reasons..
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found missing source maps, DevTools inspector issues and three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve inspector/BFCache blockers and publish valid production source maps for large first-party bundles.

findings.summary: Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchors; 21 storefront links are missing href or use #, and fixed width=1024 defeats mobile-friendly rendering.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations with descriptive text and a device-width responsive viewport.

findings.summary: HTTPS/HSTS and frame protection exist, but 31 cookies were marked insecure, most SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS and frame protection exist, but 31 cookies were marked insecure, most SameSite=None; CSP only declares frame-ancestors and nosniff is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all cookies Secure with least-permissive SameSite, add nosniff, and deploy an allowlist CSP beyond frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: Tracker probe found 41 third-party origins and eight known tracker domains.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found 41 third-party origins and eight known tracker domains; HAR attributes 315 requests/3.63MB to third parties on first load.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics on consent, consolidate tags, minimise events and remove vendors without demonstrated user value.

findings.summary: No permission prompt fired on load, but registration exposes social/email account creation and no passkey/WebAuthn option or credential autocomplete was found..
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but registration exposes social/email account creation and no passkey/WebAuthn option or credential autocomplete was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/sign-in and correct credential autocomplete alongside existing methods.

findings.summary: Headers lack Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff.
findings.evidence: Headers lack Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff; CSP is limited to frame-ancestors. HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict referrer/permissions policies, nosniff, and a nonce/hash-based script/style CSP with Trusted Types where feasible.

findings.summary: Non-JS discoverability is only 35% on storefront.
findings.evidence: Non-JS discoverability is only 35% on storefront; crawler screenshot loses main rankings/product content and leaves a large blank content region.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core listing content and use JavaScript only to enhance sorting, carousels and personalisation.

findings.summary: Blocking locale UI is custom fixed DIV rather than top-layer dialog/popover.
findings.evidence: Blocking locale UI is custom fixed DIV rather than top-layer dialog/popover; it obscures every deep link and lacks declarative dismissal semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native top-layer primitives, preserve state and ensure overlays remain recoverable at viewport edges.

findings.summary: Before any visible consent choice on the storefront, 31 cookies and 41 third-party origins are active.
findings.evidence: Before any visible consent choice on the storefront, 31 cookies and 41 third-party origins are active; the only first-load prompt is a compulsory language gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Present an honest consent choice before non-essential trackers, default to necessary-only, and preserve rejection.

findings.summary: After entering an invalid email and blurring, browser validity fails but no visible error, aria-invalid or described-by error is added..
findings.evidence: After entering an invalid email and blurring, browser validity fails but no visible error, aria-invalid or described-by error is added.
findings.suggestedFix: After interaction, show a concise visible error, set aria-invalid and connect it with aria-describedby/live announcement.

findings.summary: Registration email has no label and no autocomplete token, preventing reliable autofill assistance..
findings.evidence: Registration email has no label and no autocomplete token, preventing reliable autofill assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a persistent label and autocomplete=email/username as appropriate; use complete signup autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Pricing and purchase actions are visible, but a first-time product deep link is blocked by locale selection and registration is partly hidden by consent UI..
findings.evidence: Pricing and purchase actions are visible, but a first-time product deep link is blocked by locale selection and registration is partly hidden by consent UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep price/commitment visible and remove obstructive gates from checkout/account continuity; add autofill/passkeys.

findings.summary: Image audit found six oversized images, 40 without srcset, seven legacy-format images and 36 below-fold images loaded eagerly..
findings.evidence: Image audit found six oversized images, 40 without srcset, seven legacy-format images and 36 below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources at display size and lazy-load non-critical images.

findings.summary: First load makes 398 requests including 73 fetch/XHR and repeated analytics scripts.
findings.evidence: First load makes 398 requests including 73 fetch/XHR and repeated analytics scripts; 119 scripts contribute to long tasks and unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay, batch or remove background analytics and initialise only the modules needed for visible content.

findings.summary: Third parties consume 3.63MB across 315 requests, including 1.57MB Google Tag Manager and multiple ad/analytics vendors..
findings.evidence: Third parties consume 3.63MB across 315 requests, including 1.57MB Google Tag Manager and multiple ad/analytics vendors.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and load consented analytics after core content, with aggressive vendor pruning.

findings.summary: This commerce site is a plausible agentic purchasing/search surface, but Lighthouse agentic score is 0.32 and no WebMCP tools are registered..
findings.evidence: This commerce site is a plausible agentic purchasing/search surface, but Lighthouse agentic score is 0.32 and no WebMCP tools are registered.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe, confirmable catalogue search/cart capabilities through structured agent tools and accessible forms.

findings.summary: Baseline heap summary contains 1.57M heap nodes and 99.5MB self size for a catalogue landing page, alongside 6,650 DOM elements and 119 scripts..
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1.57M heap nodes and 99.5MB self size for a catalogue landing page, alongside 6,650 DOM elements and 119 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce DOM/card population, unload hidden widgets and remove duplicate analytics/module allocations.

taskList.title: Rebuild the mobile experience around device-width reflow and accessible zoom
Remove first-load tracking until explicit consent and secure all cookies
Cut startup JavaScript, trackers, redirects and unused bundles to restore Core Web Vitals
Replace blocking custom overlays with semantic, non-obscuring dialogs/popovers
Repair accessible names, labels, contrast, landmarks and validation feedback
Add system dark mode and reduced-motion treatment
Server-render more catalogue content and expose crawlable links
Harden browser policies and clean console/inspector/BFCache failures
Reduce baseline DOM/heap footprint and modernise navigation interactions
